comparison.objective: Cut a taped carton seam without damaging a product 6 mm below, then retract the blade; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Depth-controlled cutting along a seam and safe blade retraction versus recessed hex manipulation, fine collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and guarded cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Complete the 40 cm seam cut without reaching the product and leave the blade retracted; candidate uses force, energy, travel, rebound, and drift measurements.
comparison.reason: Controlled cutting near protected contents is a different manipulation and safety outcome.
